newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to auction 3-yr, 11pct bond, 7yr FRN Nov 22.
newsitem.headline: Greece to auction 3-yr, 11pct bond, 7yr FRN Nov 22.

text.p: Greece will auction 100 billion drachmas of three-year, 11 percent bonds and 200 billion drachmas of seven-year FRNs with the benchmark set at 12 percent and the spread at 140 basis points, a monetary source told Reuters.
The treasury had set the benchmark 12-month T-bill rate at 12.30 percent and the spread at 140 basis points in its October auction of seven-year FRNs.
Coupon payments on outstanding FRNs due today will be based on the 12 percent benchmark 12-month T-bill, the source said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
